explainer.title: What are historical archives?
explainer.description: These are player records consolidated from imported legacy world archives. Any records that were not unified by the current server login system are kept as historical archives. They are separated by player ID, the data is fixed, and it will not continue to update. Because the source data comes from backups, some details may differ from reality or be far from the current timeline. Historical archives cannot be bound manually by users; contact an administrator if binding is needed.

confirmations.unbind: Unbinding will disconnect this Minecraft account from the current Hydroline ID, while keeping the record as a dangling entry. Do you want to continue?

bind.title: Bind another Minecraft account
bind.description: Enter the game account you use on the HydCraft server. This does not verify a premium Minecraft account. It only recognizes game accounts that were registered within HydCraft and have logged in before. Accounts registered after Season 6 began on February 17, 2022 can be bound. If you have not registered within HydCraft and logged in before, binding is not possible.
